#### HealthData Platform™

## Streamline. Centralize. Safeguard.

The secure, compliant way to optimize your IT landscape, reduce costs, and manage vital patient, financial, and business records. Discover what HealthData Platform™ can do for you.

[Schedule a Demo](https://www.harmonyhit.com/contact/)

![HealthData Platform](https://www.harmonyhit.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/HealthData-Platform-Logo-New.svg)

## One Platform to Convert, Archive and Manage Data

Decrease cost, reduce risk, and gain greater control over your data to keep your focus where it matters most: supporting patient care.

**Discover HealthData Platform™.**

### Data Services

End-to-end healthcare data management—from extraction to compliant retention.

[Extraction](https://www.harmonyhit.com/services/data-services/extraction/) [Migration / Conversion](https://www.harmonyhit.com/services/data-services/migration/)

### Legacy Data Management

Optimize and protect historical data with cost-efficient storage and access.

[Hot Storage – Active Archive](https://www.harmonyhit.com/services/health-data-active-archive-solutions/) [Warm Storage](https://www.harmonyhit.com/services/health-data-warm-storage-archive/) [Cold Storage](https://www.harmonyhit.com/services/health-data-cold-storage-archive/)

### Live Data Solutions

Streamline user workflows, enhance interoperability, and support compliance related to active data.

[Contract Compliance Management](https://www.harmonyhit.com/products/contract-compliance-management/)

## Key Benefits

#### Cost Savings

Decommission outdated systems to reduce long-term IT expenses.

#### Interoperability

Seamlessly integrate archives with EHRs, analytics, and other third-party platforms.

#### Efficiency

Ease the workload on IT, compliance, HIM, clinical, and rev cycle teams.

#### Automation

Streamline user workflows and maintain compliance.

## HealthData Platform™ Helps With

- **New System Implementation** – Ensure seamless transitions with secure data extraction, [conversion](https://www.harmonyhit.com/data-conversion-process-steps/), and archival.
- **Technology Consolidation** – Rationalize applications across the enterprise to reduce cost and risk.
- **Cybersecurity** – Reduce data silos to secure your data, mitigate risks, and ensure compliance.
- **Data Interoperability** – Consolidate and integrate platforms for smoother workflows (EHRs, auditing and reporting tools, and more).
- **A/R Wind Down** – Reduce outstanding accounts receivable (A/R) balances from legacy systems.

## Security & Compliance

**Certifications:** HITRUST Certified, HIPAA-Compliant

**Measures:** 560+ security controls, encryption in transit and at rest

**Oversight:** Role-based access controls, audit logs

[Learn More](https://www.harmonyhit.com/security/)

## Primary Platform Products

[HealthData Archiver®](https://www.harmonyhit.com/products/health-data-archiver/): Secure, intuitive active archive for clinical, financial, and business records with role-based access and streamlined user workflows.

[HealthData AR Manager®](https://www.harmonyhit.com/products/a-r-management/): Comprehensive management of collections for legacy A/R records wind down.

[HealthData Locker™](https://www.harmonyhit.com/products/healthdata-locker/,): Cost-effective cold and warm storage for inactive data that does not require daily record access by staff members via a user interface.
